She surveys the land once more.
Every hallway,
Every doorway,
Every rug from wall to wall.

None oppose her,
All rejoice beneath her reign.

Great Gremlin Leader,

Great Doja!

Great Doja!

Others searched
For little dog doors...

The people watched in silent wonder.
The birds forgot their songs.
Even the Chunk looked up in awe.
The Princess simply carried on.

Sound the brass!
Let the mighty chorus sing!
